description: This file manages logging mechanisms for the lighttpd server, including file-based and pipe-based log handling, log rotation, and syslog integration.

methods.name: fdlog_pipe_spawn
methods.description: Spawns a process to handle logging via a pipe, using a filename and read file descriptor.

methods.name: fdlog_pipe_restart
methods.description: Restarts a pipe logging process if more than 5 seconds have passed since last start.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_restart
methods.description: Restarts all pipe loggers if needed based on timestamp.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_waitpid_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling child process termination and restarting pipe loggers.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_close
methods.description: Closes all pipe log file descriptors and frees resources.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_abandon_pids
methods.description: Sets all pipe loggers' pids to -1, abandoning process management.

methods.name: fdlog_pipe_serrh
methods.description: Replaces the file descriptor for a given fd with STDERR_FILENO in pipe loggers.

methods.name: fdlog_pipe_init
methods.description: Initializes a pipe logger with filename, file descriptors, and process id.

methods.name: fdlog_pipe_open
methods.description: Opens a pipe logger for a given filename, creating pipes and spawning process if needed.

methods.name: fdlog_file_init
methods.description: Initializes a file logger with filename and file descriptor.

methods.name: fdlog_file_open_fd
methods.description: Opens a log file with specific flags.

methods.name: fdlog_file_open
methods.description: Opens or creates a log file, reusing existing if available.

methods.name: fdlog_open
methods.description: Public interface to open a log, either file or pipe based on filename prefix.

methods.name: fdlog_files_flush
methods.description: Flushes all file log buffers to disk.

methods.name: fdlog_files_cycle
methods.description: Cycles log files, reopening them for log rotation.

methods.name: fdlog_files_close
methods.description: Closes all file loggers and frees resources.

methods.name: fdlog_closeall
methods.description: Closes all loggers, both file and pipe.

methods.name: fdlog_flushall
methods.description: Flushes all logs and frees buffers.

methods.name: fdlog_closelog
methods.description: Closes syslog connection if open.

methods.name: fdlog_openlog
methods.description: Opens syslog with specified facility.
